FAQ

How do I request deletion of my data?
Email us at hello@wiplabs.app with your request and the app name. We'll process it within 30 days.
I found a bug. How do I report it?
Email us with a description of the issue, your device model, and OS version. Screenshots help a lot.
Where are WIPLabs apps available?
Available on iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play). Trace Order is live on both platforms.
Who is behind WIPLabs?
WIPLabs is an indie app studio founded by İhsan Özlü — a Senior DevOps Engineer and mobile app developer based in Istanbul, Turkey. Building practical iOS and Android apps with SwiftUI and Kotlin.
